featurebase-reader._comment: Featurebase Reader MCP. Use the URL from Featurebase Settings → MCP. Keep Writer on a separate server with allowedUsers; never allowlist Writer on automations that read ticket or post text.

my-custom-server._comment: Example: your own stdio MCP server. `command` (+ optional `args`) is spawned per run; pass its credentials via the per-server `env` block.
